normalized.result: Both do the same thing, so this is just a taste call. I'll go with Version B — the "Mark read" button. The plain checkbox circle in A is fine, but a labeled button leaves no doubt about what it does; with just a hollow circle I'd second-guess whether I'm about to mark it done or accidentally delete it. Having the words "Mark read" right there tells me exactly what'll happen. So Version B is my pick.
